verdict.rationale: While Fireworks advertises an OpenAI-compatible API and drop-in replacement for inference, none of the evidence documents a GET /v1/models-style endpoint or catalog enumeration endpoint; the openapi probe returned 404s across all candidate spec paths. Missing for 10: explicit docs for a /v1/models (or equivalent) endpoint, example request/response, and any confirmation it's part of the OpenAI-compatible surface.
